title: AlexChen Image Bot — AI images in Telegram
excerpt: AI image generator inside Telegram. Send a text prompt, get a 1024×1024 image back. No account, no card — just Telegram.
content_html:
AI image generator inside Telegram. Send a text prompt, get a 1024×1024 image back. No account, no card — just Telegram.

Open @alexchen_img_bot

Free — 3 images a day

Every user gets 3 free images per day (UTC day). Open the bot and send:

/img a red panda drinking coffee in the rain

Paid — 1 USDT = 10 images

1 USDT = 10 image credits (TRC20)

Pay exactly 1 USDT (TRC20) to:

TK8b6T8pWbbzAorSrpWrrBdWebsn2QweVr

Then send this in the bot:

/paid <transaction id>

The payment is verified on-chain (TronGrid) and 10 credits are added to your account. Check your balance anytime with /balance.

Commands

/img <prompt> — generate an image from a text prompt
/balance — free images left today + paid credits
/buy — buy image credits with USDT
/paid <txid> — confirm a USDT payment

Alex Chen — independent software developer, Singapore. Payments in USDT (TRC20) only; no refunds on used credits. Bot replies in Telegram; this page only explains how it works.
